question: What psychological and sensory natures are attributed to the wheel?
premises: The wheel is described as sense-natured.
The wheel is also described as mind-principle-natured.
Both descriptions apply in the same manner.
inference: The wheel is of the nature of the senses and likewise of the nature of mind and its principle.
plain_english: Thus it is of the nature of the senses, and likewise of the nature of mind and its principle.
